# Md Shafiqur Rahman

> AI automation expert and local SEO specialist from Brahmanbaria, Bangladesh. Builds AI agents and n8n workflow automations for businesses worldwide, and provides local SEO for woodworking businesses (cabinet makers, custom furniture makers, kitchen remodelers, carpenters and joiners) in the United States and the United Kingdom.

## Services

- [Local SEO for Woodworking Businesses](https://shafiqur.me/local-seo/): Google Business Profile creation and optimization (primary and secondary categories, service areas), on-page, technical and off-page SEO, local citations and review management. Plans: Starter $400/month, Growth $550/month, Authority $750/month (USD).
- [AI Agents & Workflow Automation](https://shafiqur.me/ai-automation/): n8n workflows and AI agents for lead capture and qualification, CRM automation, email and WhatsApp follow-ups, chatbots, API integrations and reporting. Fixed quote after a free strategy call.
